description: Create a high-end cinematic product video advertisement starting from a simple product photo.

inputs.name: product_image
inputs.description: A photo of the product to be used in the advertisement.

inputs.name: scene_description
inputs.default: surrounded by fresh flowers and soft morning sunlight
inputs.description: Description of the scene or background for the product.

phases.prompt: A high-end, professional commercial photograph of the product from the reference image, {{scene_description}}. Soft studio lighting, realistic reflections, cinematic depth of field, sharp focus on the product. 8k resolution, elegant and minimal composition.

A cinematic product advertisement video. Smooth, slow-motion camera movement panning across the product. Subtle environmental movements (e.g., leaves swaying, light shifting). High-quality commercial cinematography, elegant transitions, professional look.
